text:
priya: Draft uploaded — new launch post for Redwood Optimize (internal doc). Please review headline options, CTA sequencing, SEO keywords, and legal phrasing. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XYZ (internal) Target publish window: Wed Apr 8. Primary CTA proposal: Webinar signup > HubSpot form. @alex @jordan @leah @sam :eyes:
alex: Skimmed it — strong narrative. A few headline ideas: 1) “Redwood Optimize: Cut Inference Costs Without Sacrificing Latency” 2) “Better, Faster, Cheaper LLM Inference — Meet Redwood Optimize” 3) “Save on Token Costs: How Redwood Optimize Boosts Throughput” Leaning to #2 but can iterate. Also: suggest a short deck for journalists (1-pager). :thumbsup:
jordan: Nice draft. Two SEO notes: add keywords near top — "LLM inference optimization", "inference cost reduction", "dedicated GPU inference". Suggest meta description (<=160 chars): "Redwood Optimize reduces LLM inference cost and improves latency with workload-aware batching and caching." Also please include the 3 benchmark numbers in the subtitle: p50 latency, token cost reduction %, throughput uplift. Keep raw numbers in a callout/appendix for transparency.
leah: Quick legal flag: any language claiming guaranteed savings needs qualifiers. Replace absolute claims like "cut costs by 40%" with "reduce inference costs by up to 40% in our benchmark workloads" or "typical reductions of ~X% depending on workload". Also need to avoid mentioning competitor names. I'll review the final pass — send me the exact metric callouts and the benchmark methodology table.
sam: Ops/lead routing: agree webinar signup as primary CTA. HubSpot form should have utm params and a hidden field for "source=blog" and "campaign=optimize_launch". SDR routing: webhook to /hooks/sdr/optimize with property owner = squad_sdr. Also suggest we add an option for "request private demo" as secondary CTA for enterprise visitors.
priya: thanks — making edits now. A couple micro-asks: Alex — can you pick final headline by EOD? Jordan — can you drop the 3 benchmark lines and an appendix table into the doc? Leah — I’ll DM the exact language for legal review after I add qualifiers. Sam — can you paste the HubSpot form id and the webhook path?
alex: Final headline vote: "Better, Faster, Cheaper LLM Inference — Meet Redwood Optimize" ✅. Also ok with the press 1-pager idea; will draft one-liner for the PR team.
jordan: Dropped benchmark snippets and a short methodology section at the bottom of the doc (links to Jupyter gist + raw csv). Suggested keywords added. Meta description: "Redwood Optimize cuts LLM inference costs and improves latency with smart batching, caching, and model routing."
leah: Legal quick pass: approved with edits. Use this phrasing for the savings line: "In our internal benchmark suite, Redwood Optimize reduced per-token inference costs by up to 40% on representative NLP workloads; results vary by model and input distribution." Also add: "Benchmark methodology: internal synthetic + 3 customer anonymized workloads; see appendix." You're clear to proceed once that text is in.
sam: HubSpot form id: 12345-optimize. Webhook path: https://hooks.redwood.ai/sdr/optimize. UTM example (please use exact):
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=webinar_cta
```
Also, add hidden field: lead_route=optimize_sdr_queue. I’ll work with webops to make sure webhook maps to the SDR queue.
priya: Added legal phrasing and benchmark appendix. Updated CTAs: primary = Webinar (HubSpot form 12345-optimize), secondary = Request private demo (contact form). I've also embedded the webinar registration link: https://redwood.ai/events/optimize-webinar (Apr 15).
alex: LGTM from me — go ahead with the publish queue.
leah: Legal sign-off confirmed. One tiny edit: change "representative NLP workloads" -> "representative public and partner workloads". Otherwise approved.
scheduler-bot: Publish slot booked: Wed Apr 8 10:00 UTC — draft queued.
priya: Awesome — thanks everyone. Final checklist: add byline (Priya Rao), attach 1-pager to PR brief, set HubSpot UTM as above, schedule webinar follow-up drip for registrants. I'll ping when scheduled. :party_popper:
